注意：查看 V1.0 展示
当我对我的一代不满意并且无法找到一个没有 5000 个节点和 50 个组且不美观的工作流程时，我一直在寻找 VPred 工作流程。因此，经过反复试验，为我的一族找到了一个好地方后，我决定将其注释并上传到这里。

查看我的展示，我使用不同的 LORA（希望我将它们设置正确，当您通过图像从这里获取工作流程并且它不起作用时，它会令人讨厌的 AF）。

我是一个懒惰的人，在我的世代中只尝试过一次修复，并意识到我没有时间或耐心去做，所以我通常目标是像样的第一代。如果你要修补，应该很容易修补。

有几个自定义节点包需要安装，但让 ComfyUI Manager 为您处理。

我也避免使用细节和类似的东西，因为我没有耐心，所以我尝试让脸部或其他任何东西在一次拍摄中尽可能接近。

注意：我不太清楚为什么，但 rg Three lora stacker 的行为与仅链接核心 lora 加载器不同？？？我正在测试 gens，并决定回到我的愚蠢的 lora 链接，并在完全相同的 lora 负载顺序和强度下得到了不同的结果。仅供参考

o.en:
NOTE: CHECK V1.0 FOR SHOWCASE
I was looking for a VPred workflow when I wasn't satisfied with my gens and couldn't find one that didn't have 5000 nodes with 50 groups and just not easy on the eyes. So after finding a good spot for my gens after trial and error, I decided to annotate it and upload it here.

Checkout my showcase, I use different LORAs (hopefully I set them up right, its annoying AF when you grab a workflow from here via image and it doesn't work).

I am a lazy person that has only attempted inpainting once in my genning time and realised I ain't got the time or patience for that, so I usually aim for a first gen that is decent. If you inpaint, should be pretty easy for you to touch up.

There are a couple custom node packs to install, but let the ComfyUI Manager handle that for you.

Also I avoid adetailer and similar because I am impatient, so I try for gens that get the face or whatever right as close as possible in 1 shot.

NOTE: I'm not exactly sure why, but the rgthree lora stacker acts differently to just chaining the core lora loader??? I was testing gens and decided to go back to my dumb lora chaining and got a different results with the exact same lora load orders & strength. Just an FYI
